PB_HENCH_INJURY: Remove him from the group. His equipment is lost.
He fights in the next battle as normal.
PB_XP_AWARDS: Every Hero and every Henchman group that fought, even if taken out of action — unless killed.

A Hero, for every enemy he puts out of action.

PB_HERO_ADVANCE: Choose a skill from one of the Hero's skill lists.

PB_HENCH_ADVANCE: One model of the group becomes a Hero.
PB_ADVANCE_NOTES: Racial maximum: if the characteristic is already at its maximum, take the other option — or roll again if the result raises only one characteristic.
Henchmen gain experience as a group: every model in it gets the same advance.
